title: A building-light survey
passage: Tonight, check whether our loading building lights reach the apartments. At the marked spot by the fence, the canopy blocks the parking lights. Record only floors that give off their own light. Facilities controls lights by floor. If two floors look bright, ask Facilities to switch off the higher one first. If the lower windows go completely dark, they were reflecting light from above. Photograph the building with all upper lights off for next week's reference.
passageZh: 今晚請確認裝卸大樓的光是否照到公寓。在圍欄旁的標記處，遮棚會擋住停車場的燈。只記錄本身發光的樓層。設施管理組按樓層控制燈光；兩層都亮時，請他們先關較高樓層的燈。若較低樓層的窗戶完全不亮了，表示窗戶原先反射的是上方樓層的光。上層燈全關後請拍下大樓照片，作為下星期的參照。
